claims.statement: The final deposit for the Allen-McCoole fight was due at McCoole's saloon on the night of September 2, 1873.
claims.excerpt: Last night was the time eet for the final deposit
places: McCoole's saloon, corner of Fifth and Wash streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen did not appear at the final deposit.
claims.excerpt: it was announced that neither of them would be present.
places: McCoole's saloon, corner of Fifth and Wash streets, St. Louis

notes: 'Last night' in a paper dated 1873-09-03 is 1873-09-02. The hint's description of the stakeholder is left out because it is not about Allen.
